cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with reference to a state governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Избавь мою ___, Господи, от лгущих уст.
cases.explain: The transitive verb избавь (deliver) governs the accusative case.
Человек is the predicate nominative after the copula.
The imperative verb дай (give) takes the accusative object.
The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.
The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: В скорби своей я возвал Господу, и Он ответил мне.
reading.question: What did the psalmist do in his distress?
options: He called to the Lord and the Lord answered him
reading.correct: He called to the Lord and the Lord answered him
reading.explain: The verse states: В скорби своей я возвал Господу, и Он ответил мне — In my distress I called to the Lord and He answered me.

reading.ru: Я сказал, избавь мою душу, Господи, от лгущих уст и обманчивого языка.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask to be delivered from?
options: Lying lips and a deceitful tongue
reading.correct: Lying lips and a deceitful tongue
reading.explain: The psalmist's prayer is: избавь мою душу ... от лгущих уст и обманчивого языка — Deliver my soul from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

reading.ru: Я мирный человек, но только заговорю о них войне.
reading.question: What is the contrast described in this verse?
options: The speaker is peaceful, but his enemies speak of war
He is rich but poor in spirit
He is strong but weak in faith
He is wise but foolish in action
reading.correct: The speaker is peaceful, but his enemies speak of war
reading.explain: The verse draws a contrast: Я мирный человек (I am a man of peace), но только заговорю о них войне (but when I speak of them, they speak of war).

reading.ru: Горе мне, что пребываю в Мишахе и живу среди кидарских шатров.
reading.question: What does the speaker lament about his dwelling place?
options: He dwells among hostile peoples (Mesech and Kedar) far from peace
He is separated from his family
reading.correct: He dwells among hostile peoples (Mesech and Kedar) far from peace
reading.explain: Горе мне, что пребываю в Мишахе ... среди кидарских шатров — Woe is me, that I dwell in Mesech, among the tents of Kedar (ancient peoples known for their warfare).

reading.ru: Душа моя долго жила с ненавидящими мир.
reading.question: What has the speaker's soul endured?
options: Living long among those who hate peace
reading.correct: Living long among those who hate peace
reading.explain: The verse states: Душа моя долго жила с ненавидящими мир — My soul has dwelt a long time with those who hate peace.

reading.ru: Что Он даст тебе, и что прибавит обманчивый язык?
reading.question: What is the rhetorical question asking about the deceitful tongue?
options: What reward will a deceitful tongue receive from God?
How can a tongue become deceitful?
reading.correct: What reward will a deceitful tongue receive from God?
reading.explain: The rhetorical question Что Он даст тебе, и что прибавит обманчивый язык? — What will He give you, what more will the deceitful tongue get? — implies that the deceitful tongue will receive nothing good.
